evidence: Service.FrozenContext in engine/review/app/launch.go runs BriefPair, Bind, the over-limit check, CheckBrief and withContext in the order its doc comment states, and it stores nothing.

The exit-code mapping in engine/cmd/review_frozen_context.go sends ErrInvalidBrief and ErrOverLimit to exit 2 and every other failure to exit 1, as the commit message claims. The mapping for the CheckBrief error is not visible in this diff, and the test expects exit 2 for it, so I took it as matching.
BriefPair's regexes require a full 40 or 64 hex name directly followed by a closing quote, so a longer hex string cannot produce a partial match. Repeated names are deduplicated.
The verb-list strings in review.go, usage.go, dispatch_routes_test.go, review_exempt_test.go and review_test.go agree with each other.
I found no defect caused by this change.
